## Purpose

This is a **complete implementation reference** for how the docs viewer renders markdown content visually. It covers folder/tree structures, code blocks, heading animations, inline elements, tables, lists, checklists, the Table of Contents, view modes, the welcome/landing page, and sidebar navigation.

Any AI or developer can use this set of documents to replicate the exact rendering behavior.

## Conventions

- **Screenshots** are stored in `public/images/guide/` (light + dark variants).
- **All colors are HSL via CSS custom properties** — never hardcoded hex.
- **Code blocks** always render dark, regardless of app theme mode.
